description: Stereo mixer channel strip for the Daisy Mix chain, adding its signal to the running mix carried across touching modules

params.text: Sets the level of this strip, silence at the bottom and 0dB at the top, though the tooltip reads half the attenuation applied, so its -6dB is really -12dB
Click to mute the strip, which lights red; hold the button for about a second to solo it instead, which lights green
Pans this strip between left and right at constant power, centred at noon

inputs.text: The left input, and the whole signal when the right input is unpatched, in which case it is copied to both sides before panning
The right input for this strip; leaving it unpatched sends the left input to both sides
Scales the level of this strip, 0-10V for silence to the fader setting, with voltage outside that range clamped

outputs.text: The left side of this strip after the fader, the level CV and the pan, silent while the strip is muted unless the menu sets the direct outs pre-mute
The right side of this strip after the fader, the level CV and the pan, silent while the strip is muted unless the menu sets the direct outs pre-mute

notes: A strip takes the running mix from the daisy module touching its left edge and passes that mix plus its own signal to the one touching its right edge, ending at a D-MX2 master
The two lamps in the blue DAISY band light when a daisy module is linked on the left and on the right, and the red number shows this strip's place in the chain
When a strip anywhere in the chain is soloed, the master carries only the soloed strips
With the mouse over this module, pressing m toggles mute and pressing s toggles solo
Up to 16 strips can feed one master
The strip adds nothing to any mix on its own: it needs a D-MX2 master at the right-hand end of an unbroken run of touching daisy modules.
menu: Aux Group 1 Send Amt — a slider setting how much of this strip, taken after the fader, is passed down the chain to an AUX module set to group 1, 0% to 100%, and 0% until it is moved
Aux Group 2 Send Amt — a slider setting how much of this strip, taken after the fader, is passed down the chain to an AUX module set to group 2, 0% to 100%, and 0% until it is moved
Direct outs pre-mute — keeps the OUT jacks sounding while the strip is muted, so the strip can be processed elsewhere without its dry signal in the mix
Smooth level CV — adds a 6ms slew to the level CV input, softening abrupt changes of level; it is ticked by default
